summary: Retested the trip legs / arrival types / Returning to Dock fold fixes from iteration 175 at 390px (choices also checked at 1920px) as test-admin-1 / main. The boat was backed up to /tmp/bk176/boat.json, seeded with /tmp/seed175.py before each run, and restored afterwards with mongoimport --mode=upsert (checked: legs null, arrive {}). PASSED: (1) HIGH repro: a standalone Returning to Dock ARRIVED, then DEPART, then Returning to Dock ARRIVED with the same levels. The earlier standalone 'Arrival check (Returning to Dock)' and 'Arrived' entries stay in the log and are NOT in the Trip entry. A fresh arrival status entry with '(was Full)' was created and folded. After the fold depart={} and arrive={}. (2) Full 4-leg use case: one Trip entry, 'Trip - Route Plan: Route Planning - Mana Marina to Mana Marina, 14/11/2026 - 4 legs - ...' (a single date). Legs 1-4 have the right kinds and the departed times are the actual tap times (22:03, 22:04, ...). The folded arrival status entries say 'Used on the passage Tawa Bay to Picton Marina', 'Picton Marina to Anatohia Bay' and 'Anatohia Bay to Mana Marina'. Leg 1 correctly says Mana Marina to Tawa Bay. Only the 2 unrelated entries are left in the log. boat.depart={} and arrive={}, and Leaving Dock / Arriving at Destination are not collapsed after the fold. (3) After the fold and on every fresh arrival, the status step says 'Copy the ...'. (4) The choice buttons are left-aligned at 390 and 1920: text-align left, justify flex-start, label and description start at the same x right after the icon. FAILED: (A) A false 'Changed since it was copied.' still shows on the collapsed Arrival status check after ARRIVED on legs 2 and 3. (B) After the arrival status entry is deleted from the Ship's Log, the ARRIVED window says 'Update the arrival levels...', not 'Copy the ...', and the Arrival card still says 'Arrival status logged.' test_interim_legs.py passes 4/4.

ui_bugs.component: legBoat (lib/tripFold.js) used by ArrivalCheck after ARRIVED on Arriving at Destination
ui_bugs.issue: A false 'Changed since it was copied.' shows in arrival-collapsed-summary after ARRIVED for every leg after an interim departure (legs 2 and 3 in the use case). RCA: arrive() saves log_sig computed with legBoat(b) while underway is still set (route Tawa Bay->Picton). It then sets underway={}, so legBoat(boat) in BoatPrep finds no legs (b.legs[undefined]) and falls back to boat.route_start/route_dest (Mana Marina->Tawa Bay). ArrivalCheck's sig then differs from arrive.log_sig. Leg 1 is fine only because the dock leg route equals boat.route_*. Fix: in legBoat use b.legs?.[b.underway?.trip_id || b.route_trip] (legs are kept until the fold), or save the leg route on boat.arrive and use it.

ui_bugs.component: statusStep (useAllDone.js) and ArrivalCheck when the copied entry was deleted from the Ship's Log
ui_bugs.issue: After the arrival status entry is deleted from the Ship's Log (checklist-item-delete-<id> + Delete), the ARRIVED window shows 'Update the arrival levels and what was used into the Ship's Log', not 'Copy the ...'. The verb is chosen with `d.log_id ? 'Update' : 'Copy'`, without checking the id is still in the log. The Arrival status card also still shows 'Arrival status logged.' with the checkbox ticked, because arrive.log_id is stale. putLog does correctly create a new entry. Fix: compute exists = log.some(i => i.id === d.log_id) and use exists for both done and the Update/Copy verb. Optionally pass shipsLog to ArrivalCheck/DepartureCheck so 'logged' needs the id to exist.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix the false 'Changed since it was copied.' after ARRIVED on legs after an interim departure. legBoat should find the legs by b.underway?.trip_id || b.route_trip (underway is cleared by arrive()), or the leg route should be stored on boat.arrive.
LOW: statusStep should say 'Copy' (not 'Update') when d.log_id is no longer in shipsLog. Optionally make the ArrivalCheck/DepartureCheck 'logged' state need the entry to still exist.
critical_code_review_comments: legBoat depends on underway.trip_id, but underway is cleared on each ARRIVED, so anything that uses legBoat between ARRIVED and the next departure (ArrivalCheck sig, and an ARRIVED reopened before New departure) gets the overall route, not the leg route.
statusStep: the 'Update' wording ignores whether the entry still exists (`d.log_id ? 'Update' : 'Copy'`).

success_rate.frontend: about 85% (the HIGH, fold, passage text, single-date title, tap times, reset after fold and alignment all pass; the false 'Changed' on legs 2+ and the deleted-entry wording fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Back up with mongoexport -q '{"owner_id":"test-admin-1","boat_id":"main"}', seed /tmp/seed175.py, check /tmp/chk175b.py, then restore. The arrival log checkbox (arrival-log-checkbox) collapses the card on click, so use click() not check().
